question: In Box: Add the tag harbor-final to the favorited copy of Harbor launch plan.pdf in the Harbor Launch folder that also has the Harbor budget spreadsheet.
final:
Done. Added the `harbor-final` tag to **Harbor launch plan.pdf** (file 8110) — the favorited copy in the Harbor Launch folder that sits alongside Harbor budget.xlsx. Verified the tag is now set: `['harbor-final']`.

Note: there were a few other favorited copies of the launch plan, but this was the only one in the folder with the budget spreadsheet (the other folder, Archive 2025/Harbor Launch, had a PDF budget instead).
